scope: W15 A09-02/03 positive source-conflict resolution and adjacent authority boundaries
required_invariants: Only OPEN EVIDENCE conflicts whose subject refs are all current project Artifact source refs enter the new branch; existing DecisionReceipt same-lineage branch is retained.

Resolution Decision must be DECIDED, pass deterministic hard checks, have exact Conflict subject ref and full exact source refs in both input/evidence refs, with explicit applicability/resolution reason.
Integration Task and current ContextBundle must be materially bound to the same conflict, selected decision and sources; a different or unrelated integration task must not authorize resolution.
Every proposal conflict must have a corresponding resolution. A global integration boolean or unrelated decision cannot resolve another conflict.

Independent acceptance must compare authority roots of proposal/value/decision authors and verifier, verify current verifier role and project grant, bind exact proposal contract/policy and server receipt hash. Recheck before apply and later skill use as appropriate.
Revalidate inputs and frozen conflict set across create/accept/apply. A later source withdrawal, changed input or added unresolved conflict cannot be hidden by an old accepted proposal.

Atomic OPEN-to-RESOLVED increments Conflict revision. The selected Decision references the prior OPEN version; a narrow applied-resolution historical rule is needed to retain legitimate adopted-decision currentness without globally ignoring Conflict version changes.

A resolved skill conflict ledger retains all source provenance and authoritative APPLIED resolution evidence; OPEN still blocks acceptance/promotion and newly OPEN source conflicts continue blocking active use.
planned_runtime_checks: Public HTTP positive source conflict decision -> integration task/context -> sealed value -> proposal -> independent acceptance -> atomic apply -> resolved source ledger -> trusted W10 skill acceptance/promotion.
Missing/altered source evidence, wrong conflict subject, unrelated task, author self-acceptance and proposal/receipt mismatch cannot resolve.
An additional unmatched conflict cannot be silently resolved; failure leaves original Conflict OPEN.
After apply, adopted decision remains usable under narrowly authenticated history; stale/revoked source still invalidates.
Original three P1 fixes remain recorded as independently verified; no repetition of full lifecycle/full package.
